# The pier: a 1.4 x 3.6 m deck from the quay (y 2.2) out to y -1.4, its top at 0.5, on six posts
# 0.18 square that stand 0.1 proud of the deck (mooring posts). Planks run across the pier:
# textures/planks.png (10 x 24 texels over the deck, 0.14 m a texel). In place.
new
add mesh cube --name Deck --size 1 --location 0.3 0.4 0.44
scale 1.4 3.6 0.12
apply
material new Planks --base-color 1 1 1
material texture Planks base-color textures/planks.png
active Deck
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
material new Post --base-color 0.529 0.400 0.447 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name PostA --size 1 --location -0.32 -1.2 0
scale 0.18 0.18 1.2
add mesh cube --name PostB --size 1 --location 0.92 -1.2 0
scale 0.18 0.18 1.2
add mesh cube --name PostC --size 1 --location -0.32 0 0
scale 0.18 0.18 1.2
add mesh cube --name PostD --size 1 --location 0.92 0 0
scale 0.18 0.18 1.2
add mesh cube --name PostE --size 1 --location -0.32 1.2 0
scale 0.18 0.18 1.2
add mesh cube --name PostF --size 1 --location 0.92 1.2 0
scale 0.18 0.18 1.2
select PostA PostB PostC PostD PostE PostF
apply
material assign Post
select all
shade flat
export pier.glb
